description: Main server program for MsgBusTestServer, handling signal processing, daemonization, and message bus engagement.

methods.name: cmd_dispatch
methods.description: Handles command input characters to perform actions like connecting to bus, printing memory, or canceling.

methods.name: _print_stack_backtrace
methods.description: Prints the current call stack for debugging purposes.

methods.name: daemonize
methods.description: Turns the process into a daemon by forking and detaching from terminal.

methods.name: sig_handler
methods.description: Handles various Unix signals, including termination and user-defined signals, with stack trace on critical signals.
